title: GdprDataBreach
description: GDPR-sourced archetype — personal data breach notification under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Articles 33-34 define the obligation to notify the supervisory authority and, in high-risk cases, the data subjects. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: GDPR Articles 33, 34.

personalDataBreach.description: Whether a personal data breach has occurred — a breach of security leading to accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, unauthorised disclosure of, or access to, personal data. Source: GDPR Art 4(12).

breachType.description: Type of breach. CONFIDENTIALITY: unauthorised or accidental disclosure or access. INTEGRITY: unauthorised or accidental alteration. AVAILABILITY: accidental or unauthorised loss of access or destruction.

riskToRightsAndFreedoms.description: Assessed level of risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons. UNLIKELY: notification to supervisory authority not required (Art 33(1) exception). LIKELY: notification to supervisory authority required within 72 hours (Art 33(1)). HIGH: notification to data subjects also required without undue delay (Art 34(1)).

authorityNotified.description: Whether the supervisory authority has been notified. Required within 72 hours unless risk is unlikely. Source: GDPR Art 33(1).

authorityNotificationHours.description: Hours from becoming aware of the breach to notifying the supervisory authority. Deadline: 72 hours. Source: GDPR Art 33(1).

dataSubjectsNotified.description: Whether affected data subjects have been notified. Required without undue delay when risk is HIGH. Source: GDPR Art 34(1).

breachDocumented.description: Whether the breach has been documented including facts, effects, and remedial action taken. Controller must document any breach regardless of notification obligation. Source: GDPR Art 33(5).

notificationContentsComplete.description: Whether the notification contains all required elements: nature of breach, DPO contact, likely consequences, and measures taken/proposed to address the breach. Source: GDPR Art 33(3)(a)-(d).
